TextBlock.Text: LAURUS: Wherever our search for the Eye will lead us, I find peace in knowing that we gave everything we could in order to seek and comprehend.

LAURUS: Our efforts and sacrifices will serve a purpose far greater than ourselves. The project will truly make a difference about how we understand reality. Do not be worried, my dear; we should take pride in what we have achieved.

LUMA: Oh Laurus, I wish I shared your certainty. Your words are comforting, but my mind wanders to the statues. If the Project succeeds, those who will see the Eye will have our memories... but will it be us? Or will we have perished in the first fire, leaving only a ghost of data behind?
LAURUS: If our thoughts continue, Luma, then we continue. Is there a difference between a soul and the story it tells?
